# NFL Daily — 2026-11-06 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Ravens acquired QB Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals, sending a 2027 fourth-rounder and a 2028 seventh for Brissett and a 2027 fifth. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50400123/ravens-complete-trade-cardinals-qb-jacoby-brissett)
- Ravens placed QBs Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) on injured reserve. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-tyler-huntley-injured-reserve-austin-reed-adisa-isaac-jake-moody)
- Browns bench Deshaun Watson (concussion protocol), start Shedeur Sanders for the first time this season Sunday at the Saints. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50400928/browns-start-shedeur-sanders-qb-vs-saints)
- Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson was hospitalized for several days with "unexplained neurological symptoms"; tests have come back reassuring so far. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50400016/patriots-treveyon-henderson-affected-neurological-symptoms)
- Rams DE Myles Garrett is expected to be activated off IR and play Sunday vs. the Commanders after practicing all week on his surgically repaired knee. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50400738/sources-rams-myles-garrett-track-return-vs-commanders)

## Transactions
- Ravens acquired QB Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals for a 2027 fourth-round pick and a 2028 seventh, getting back a 2027 fifth. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/transactions)

- Ravens QBs Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) are both on injured reserve. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-tyler-huntley-injured-reserve-austin-reed-adisa-isaac-jake-moody)

- Jets WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) is ruled out for Sunday vs. the Chiefs. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2118809466351014380)
- Rams DE Myles Garrett (knee) is expected to be activated off IR and play Sunday vs. the Commanders. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50400738/sources-rams-myles-garrett-track-return-vs-commanders)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-06 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Ravens acquired QB Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals, sending a 2027 fourth-rounder and a 2028 seventh for Brissett and a 2027 fifth. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jacoby-brissett-ravens-trade-cardinals-finalize-2026)
- Ravens placed QBs Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) on injured reserve, leaving Brissett, Joe Fagnano and Austin Reed as the healthy QBs. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-tyler-huntley-injured-reserve-austin-reed-adisa-isaac-jake-moody)
- S Kyle Hamilton left Thursday's loss to the Jaguars with a hip injury and was ruled out. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/kyle-hamilton-hip-injury-ravens-ruled-out)
- Ravens fell to the Jaguars 33-10, a fourth straight loss and third straight by 20+ points, dropping Baltimore below .500. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2118704967674425615)
